steps.title: Sample Preparation and Storage
steps.instruction: Organize plasma samples in random order on dry ice and store at -80 °C until extraction.

steps.title: Initial Supernatant Processing
steps.instruction: Separate the supernatant from the pellets.

substeps.instruction: Transfer supernatant for Hilicneg - C18pos analysis and QCpool (1 mL).
Keep pellets for future protein assay (BCA).
Aliquoting QCpool: 1 mL (or more) depending on available volume.

steps.title: Supernatant Drying and Storage
steps.instruction: Dry the supernatants and store them.

substeps.instruction: Dry supernatants under a nitrogen stream at 30 °C using a TurboVap LV (Evaporator, BIOTAGE, TurboVap® LV).
Vortex for 5 s.
Store at -20 °C until analysis.
Add 170 µL of Water LC-MS Chromasolv (Fisher Scientific Catalog #15665350).
Sonicate samples using a Vibracell VCX 130 (Ultrasonic processor, Sonics, 432-0135) with a 2 mm probe for 10 s at 40% amplitude.

steps.title: Protein Precipitation
steps.instruction: Perform protein precipitation and aliquot the resulting supernatants.

substeps.instruction: Transfer 20 µL of homogenate into a Lobind tube for future protein assay (BCA).
Add 350 µL of MeOH with internal standards to the remaining 150 µL volume.
Vortex for 5 s.
Incubate on ice for 90 min until complete protein precipitation.
Transfer supernatants as follows: 150 µL for Hilicneg analysis, 150 µL for C18pos analysis, and the remaining volume (about 150 µL) for QCpool.
Aliquote QCpool (150 µL).

steps.title: Secondary Supernatant Drying
steps.instruction: Dry the precipitated supernatants and store.

substeps.instruction: Dry supernatants under a nitrogen stream at 30 °C using a TurboVap LV (Evaporator, BIOTAGE, TurboVap® LV).
Store at -20 °C until analysis.

steps.title: BCA Protein Assay
steps.instruction: Quantify protein content to determine reconstitution volumes.

substeps.instruction: Pipette 20 µL of each blank, standard, and sample into a well plate.
Add 200 µL of colored reagent.
Incubate the plate at 100 rpm, 40 °C, for 20 min.
Read the plate at 562 nm (range 540-590 nm).
Subtract average absorbance of blank replicates from all other replicates; use quadratic curve fitting for results.

steps.title: Hilic Analysis Mobile Phase Preparation
steps.instruction: Prepare mobile phases for Hilic analysis.

substeps.instruction: Mobile Phase A: Add 0.9606 mg ammonium carbonate (Merck MilliporeSigma Catalog #379999) to 1L of water (Fisher Scientific Catalog #15665350) to achieve 10 mM; adjust pH to 10.5 using ammonia solution 25% (Merck MilliporeSigma Catalog #5438300100).
Mobile Phase B: 100% acetonitrile (Biosolve Catalog #0001204101BS).

steps.title: Hilic Analysis Reconstitution
steps.instruction: Reconstitute dried extracts for Hilic analysis in two steps based on protein assay results.

substeps.instruction: Reconstitute samples at a ratio of 1 mg protein / 50 µL (adapt ratio if final volume is < 75 µL or > 300 µL).
Step 1: Add 40% (of final volume) of mobile phase A containing 2.5x External Standards (ES*).
Vortex for 5 s.
Step 2: Add 60% (of final volume) of mobile phase B.
Transfer supernatant into 0.2 mL vials for LC-MS analysis.

steps.title: C18 Analysis Mobile Phase Preparation
steps.instruction: Prepare mobile phases for C18 analysis.

substeps.instruction: Mobile Phase A: Add 1 mL formic acid (Fisher Scientific Catalog #10780320) to 1L water.
Mobile Phase B: Add 1 mL formic acid (Fisher Scientific Catalog #10780320) to 1L acetonitrile.

steps.title: C18 Analysis Reconstitution
steps.instruction: Reconstitute dried extracts for C18 analysis in one step based on protein assay results.

substeps.instruction: Reconstitute samples at a ratio of 1 mg protein / 50 µL (adapt ratio if final volume is < 75 µL or > 300 µL).
Add a mix of mobile phase A / mobile phase B / ES* in a 90/5/5 ratio.
Vortex for 5 s.
Transfer supernatant into 0.2 mL vials for LC-MS analysis.
For QC reconstitution, set final volume as the average of all sample volumes.
Prepare 2-fold, 4-fold, and 8-fold diluted QC samples in mobile phases.
Vortex for 5 s.
